environment.description: Same Quarkus Lambda function deployed as a private integration target. The API Gateway is configured as a PRIVATE REST API (not HTTP API) with a resource policy that denies all traffic except from VPC endpoint vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890. The VPC endpoint itself has a custom endpoint policy restricting invoke access to principals within OU ou-abc1-reportteam only. Additionally, the VPC's route tables contain no IGW or NAT gateway routes (isolated subnets), and the security group on the VPC endpoint (sg-0fedcba987654321) restricts ingress to CIDR 10.42.8.0/24 (the reporting service subnet). DNS resolution for the API is only available via the VPC endpoint's private DNS entry.

config.vpc_routing: isolated subnets, no IGW, no NAT, no peering to public-facing VPCs
config.dns: private DNS enabled on VPCE, no public DNS resolution for API endpoint
